notes: CHIPs the port adds after the original's 96 (indices 0-95). docs/CUSTOM_CHIPS.md explains how to recreate or add one: the face picture, the stats and the chatter.

Each family becomes one record per entry of "chatter" (the personality table in tables/chatter.json), numbered on from first_index in this order: Cat V 96-100, Cat VI 101-105, Cat VII 106-110. Saves and shop days name CHIPs by number, so only ever append families or personalities at the end.

"stats" are the original record fields (inner/outer sight shape and size curves, track, lock_frames, weight, critical_percent, dodge_percent = Repulsion Shield chance, knockdown_resistance, price), as in the converted tables/parts.json. A curve is base at level 0, base+mid at its knee and base+top at level 99.

"shop" adds one BUY CHIP offer to the given rotating shop day (0-23, garage.json chip_lineups), naming the family and its personality. The shop help texts are ui/chip_shop.json chip_help at the same index.
Not applied to S.L.A.I.'s tables, which are another game's.

families.name: Cat V
families.traits: Black; very playful; hunts flies very well (track 3, lock 8 frames); would never attack a human and uses the softest touch (low critical); very fast (best Repulsion Shield, 1% rising to 10.5%); indoor cat, so not a survivor (low knockdown resistance).

families.name: Cat VI
families.traits: Orange; playful but can get aggressive (highest cat critical); very talkative (help text only; chatter is the shared cat set); hunts flies as well as Cat V (track 3, lock 8 frames); hyperactive fast (Repulsion Shield close to Cat V); small for a Maine Coon (low knockdown resistance, Cat IV weight). Price x1.15 of the other cats.

families.name: Cat VII
families.traits: Grey; cuddly and playful when they want to be (Repulsion Shield starts at 0.5% and climbs late to 10.5%, level with Cat V); a princess in demands (price x1.3); lazy (track 1, lock 22 frames); strokes things with the paws (lowest critical); a big cat (heaviest, best knockdown resistance).
